style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright white daylight
subject: ONE potto, shaggy golden brown fur, huge round eyes, short tail, strong gripping hands; same animal
second_characters: two tree frogs in bow ties, croupiers, huge at the lens

props.tokens: blank round tokens, no markings, heaped on the table
props.coin: ONE gold coin with a bitcoin sign on it, held to the end
props.rake: ONE wooden rake, dragged at him

environment: an open air betting floor on a jungle clearing at noon, a dense wall of leaves, vines and betting tables filling the frame to its top edge, pollen and leaves flying
lighting: flat white daylight through the canopy, cyan edge left, warm amber fill right, no shade
motion_rule: the world flies INTO the hero: the frogs hurl tokens, leaves and pollen at the glass every beat and he beats them off. He throws his body the full frame width ALWAYS SIDEWAYS, filling half the frame height, muzzle to the lens, both hands working. Nothing parks him: the rake only slides and is dragged at him. The camera never stops and circles him, new shot size every beat, medium to close. ONE hero action per beat.

audio.rate: 3.5 syllables per second, each line fits its beat
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, speech ends by 5.55, then tokens and leaves carry the track
audio.lip_sync: jaw opens on every syllable, mouth empty while speaking, tokens held in his hands
audio.pronunciation: KRIP-ta, ka-zi-NO, vy-I-gra-yesh, vsyeg-DA, TOL-ko, ty

timeline.a: hurls both arms through a heap of tokens and they burst into the lens; a bow tie crosses the glass
throws his body the full frame width along the table, batting tokens off the glass; a frog shoves the rake at him
rakes a whole heap to his chest on the swing, muzzle to the lens; both frogs tumble over the glass
whips the full width the other way as the heap is dragged out of his arms; tokens shoot across the lens
throws both arms up and the frogs pour tokens over him at the glass, leaves bursting
both frogs drag the whole pile away from the lens and he swings his whole body after it, arms full width
one frog presses the gold bitcoin coin into his palm across the lens and his fist closes on it
he drives that bitcoin coin at the lens, fist filling the frame, throwing his body the full width behind it
he beats a wave of tokens off the glass with his free arm, leaves and pollen bursting at the lens
he whips the full width the other way across the bare table and shoves the rake past the lens
he slams his free hand down and tokens shoot at the glass; a frog tumbles over the lens
he drives the bitcoin coin and his muzzle into the lens together, fist and face filling the frame

must_appear: at 0.00 he hurls both arms through a heap of tokens and they burst into the lens, a bow tie across the glass; the frogs drag the whole pile away at 5.55; at 6.15 one frog presses ONE gold coin with a bitcoin sign into his palm; he holds that coin in his hand to the end; at 9.20 he drives it and his muzzle into the lens, fist filling the frame
negative_prompt: printed words, digits, Cyrillic, subtitles, watermark, speech bubble, black bars, a horizontal 16:9 frame, night, dark scene, studio lighting, glowing screens, a prop worked in place, hero riding a belt or cart, a hero held in one pose, parked camera, push in, motionless or empty background, wide shot, view from behind, lowered head during speech, a motionless first or last second, a beat without the hero, speech after 5.55, offscreen narration, English speech, a second potto
